description_en: Creates an image sensitive information scan task and returns the task ID
description_zh: 用于创建图片敏感信息扫描任务并返回任务ID
name: CreateSensitiveScanTask

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests. `ClientToken` supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be scanned. Only HTTP/HTTPS protocols are supported. The image size cannot exceed 10 MB. You must specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待扫描图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。图片大小不超过 10 MB。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url
